title: Preparation of 0.1M Tris HCl, pH 6.4
author: Nicola O'Reilly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfeyjjfw
materials: Please select between the recipes for 1 L 0.1M Tris HCl pH 6.4 and 5 L 0.1M Tris HCl pH 6.4 . Work in fume hood!

steps.title: Prepare 1 L of 0.1M Tris HCl
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 L solution of 0.1M Tris HCl, pH 6.4.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 15.76 g of Tris HCl and add to a 1 L beaker.
Measure out 800 mL of milliQ water and add to the beaker.
Add a magnetic flea and place on a magnetic stirring plate to mix the solution.
Insert a newly calibrated pH meter into the solution to observe the pH.
Transfer the solution to a 1 L graduated cylinder and bring the volume up to 1000 mL using milliQ water; swirl.
Label the container with the batch number and date.
Store the 1 L, 0.1 M Tris HCl, pH 6.4 solution at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare 5 L of 0.1M Tris HCl
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5 L solution of 0.1M Tris HCl, pH 6.4.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 78.8 g of Tris HCl and add to a 5 L beaker.
Measure out 4 L of milliQ water and add to the beaker.
Add a magnetic flea and place on a magnetic stirring plate to mix the solution.
Insert a newly calibrated pH meter into the solution to observe the pH.
Transfer the solution to a second 5 L beaker via a 2 L graduated cylinder and bring the volume up to 5 L using milliQ water; swirl.
Label the container with the batch number and date.
Store the 0.1 Molarity (M) Tris HCl, pH 6.4 solution at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).
